-- class: contract

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."tasks" (
  "id" text not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-matview
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create materialized view "public"."sums" as SELECT id, title FROM tasks with no data;

grant select on table "public"."sums" to "app_17415255d280";

revoke insert, update, delete on table "public"."sums" from "app_17415255d280";
